source:
App [ textColor = whitesmoke,
    open: boolean = false,
    onMouseDown() { open = !open },
    card: View [ x = center, y = center, width = 80%, height = 70,
        cornerRadius = 10, fill = midnightblue,
        Text [ x = 20, y = 20, fontWeight = bold, text = "Summary" ],
        big: State [ applied = { open }, height = 180, fill = steelblue,
            Text [ x = 20, y = 60, width = { parent.width - 40 }, textColor = gainsboro, wrap = true,
                text = "height, color, and this whole line swap in together" ],
            ],
        ],
    ]
